original_question: For integers k > 1 and D > 3, let chi_k(D) be the maximum chromatic number of G^k over all graphs G with maximum degree at most D, and let omega_k(D) be the corresponding maximum clique number of G^k. Is it always true that chi_k(D) = omega_k(D) for every such pair (k, D)?

refined_question: Wegner’s Conjecture. For all integers k ≥ 1 and D ≥ 3, let χ_k(D) and ω_k(D) denote, respectively, the maximums over all graphs G with maximum degree Δ(G) ≤ D of χ(G^k) and ω(G^k), where G^k is the graph obtained from G by joining every pair of vertices whose distance in G is at most k. Is it true that χ_k(D) = ω_k(D) for every k and D? citeturn12view0turn15view0
